semiconductor_relevance: High — Quark Technology provides specialized UV light sources integral to semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Quark Technology manufactures UV light sources, including Excimer and UV-LED systems, for semiconductor manufacturing. Their products are used to remove organic matter and resist residue from masks and wafers, and are also applied in the production of flat panel displays and electronic substrates.
capabilities: Excimer UV Irradiation System with 172nm light
355nm UV laser paired with an optical system
